auditGateDefects.finding: The focused hardening mutation gate is red because its synthetic complete artifact omits the now-required producedBy provenance and deterministic-render proof. The baseline is denied, so its downstream denial matrix is not currently probative.

The checkout verifier contains stale source-text expectations: it expects the old packetStatus ternary although the webhook explicitly writes pending after queue admission, and requires pathway_label metadata that the current adapter does not emit. The verifier is red; manual inspection did not establish a participant-writable payment bypass.

The delivery verifier reports MA as not a paid route and cannot complete its DB-backed check without Supabase environment variables. This is a fail-closed finding, not evidence of opened delivery, but leaves the focused delivery gate red.
